prompt: Which tropical rainforest represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth and comprises one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world?
answer: The **Congolian rainforest (Congo Basin rainforest)** in Central Africa. It represents roughly a quarter of the world’s remaining tropical forests and is one of Earth’s largest and most biodiverse rainforest regions.
